fields.Line_Item_Charges.Line item Description: Energy Consumption (920 kWh at $0.085/kWh), Delivery/Distribution Charge, Supply/Generation Charge, Wyoming Energy Surcharge, Taxes & Fees

notes.MeterRead.Previous value/Delta: This bill only states 'Current Usage: 920 kWh' - it has no actual previous/current register reading pair (unlike the -scan variant of this document, which does). The 'Usage Comparison' chart's 860 kWh and 940 kWh bars are 'previous period' and 'same period last year' comparisons, not a sequential prior meter reading - LLM's -20kWh delta (920-940) wrongly treats the 'same period last year' bar as the prior reading.
notes.Is_PrevGreaterThanCurr: Not derivable for the same reason - no genuine previous register reading exists on this document.
notes.Usage.power factor: This schema field is presumably mislabeled - the document has no true electrical 'power factor' value (normally a 0-1 ratio); the only per-unit figure is 'Rate per kWh: $0.085', which is what both extractors actually captured here.
notes.UsageMult: No meter multiplier is mentioned on this document.
notes.MeterRead.Current value: Printed/derived as "920 kWh"; kept as the bare number here since this is a 'number'-typed field and the unit already lives separately in MeterRead.Usage Unit ("kWh").
